notes.title: The Mixologist Update v1.0.6
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce the latest update to *The Mixologist*! 🎉 In this update, we’ve introduced a new collection of avatars that take your gameplay and immersive interactions to the next level. 

Dive in, try it out, and let us know what you think! 🍹✨

Stay tuned for more exciting features coming soon!

notes.title: The Mixologist Update v1.0.5 - Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Season’s Greetings, Mixologists!

The festive season has arrived, and your favorite VR bar is ready to celebrate! With this update, we’re bringing a touch of holiday magic to your bartending adventures.

[b]✨ Festive Decorations[/b]

Your bar has been transformed into a cozy winter wonderland! Twinkling lights, sparkling ornaments, and a dusting of snow set the perfect mood for the season. Whether you're serving regulars or new customers, the holiday spirit will make every drink you mix feel extra special.

Grab your VR headset, step behind the bar, and enjoy the cozy charm of *The Mixologist* this holiday season. This is the perfect chance to show off your skills and spread some festive cheer!

From all of us at *The Mixologist*, we wish you a joyous holiday season filled with good vibes and great drinks.

🍸✨ Cheers,

The Mixologist Team

notes.title: The Mixologist Update v1.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Bartenders![/b]

We’re shaking things up in *The Mixologist* with a brand-new update! Here’s what’s new:

[h1]🥇 Achievements & Collectible Trophies[/h1]

Show off your bartending prowess with achievements! Unlock trophies for your collection and prove you’re the ultimate mixologist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174748/8f303cb1cf7fe1043f2f8a5ec93b49133ebffbd5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174748/48c1c7dbbd8d697689f3aa9ef6f0e4d27b5297f4.jpg[/img]

[h1]✨ Sleek New UI[/h1]

We’ve revamped the interface to make your bartending experience smoother, faster, and more intuitive than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174748/444418ea7f7e9aadd94aac0f63ae154e54b6f6cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]🍸 New Co-op Shaker[/h1]

You asked, we listened! A second shaker is now available for even more cooperative cocktail crafting fun with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174748/ab11e4bc3e8457f76ce1b2e3eea14515be5f8d11.jpg[/img]

We can’t wait to see you behind the bar, crafting your signature cocktails. Cheers! 🥂

[h3]See you in The Mixologist![/h3]
